messages:
maria: Quick copy pass for a few tiny UI microcopy items — trying to keep everything concise and accessible. Posting proposed text and a11y notes.

ash: thanks! drop the current screenshots? will review in-thread. :eyes:

maria: Sure — top of thread: EMPTY STATE for Saved Prompts panel. Current: "No saved prompts yet. Save prompts to reuse them."

maria: Proposed A: "No saved prompts yet. Create one to reuse later."

maria: Proposed B (short CTA): "No saved prompts. Create a prompt"

sam: I prefer A — reads less like a bug and gives the explicit value (reuse). B feels like a label more than a sentence.

ash: Agree with Sam. Also accessibility nit: ensure the empty state uses an h2 heading so screen readers announce it properly, and the CTA should be a real button not a link.

devon: For the illustration alt text: use "Illustration of a saved prompt card with a plus sign" — descriptive but brief. Avoid "empty state" in alt.

maria: Noted. Next: Tooltip for the "Auto-batching" toggle in Runtime settings. Current tooltip: "Batch requests to reduce cost"

maria: Proposed options: 
- Short: "Batch requests to lower token cost."
- Explainer: "Automatically group similar requests to reduce cost; may add 20–50ms latency."

olivia: I like the explainer but we should keep the tooltip under ~120 chars. Also parentheses for the latency feels techy — maybe say "may add a small delay" so product copy is friendlier.

ash: Suggestion: "Group compatible requests to reduce per-token cost; may add a small delay." (120 chars-ish)

sam: Also add aria-describedby reference for the tooltip so screen readers can trigger the longer explanation if user focuses the toggle.

design-bot: Reminder: tooltip length rule = <120 chars for desktop, <80 for mobile per design system.

maria: Good call. Final tooltip to use: "Group compatible requests to reduce per-token cost; may add a small delay." — will keep longer explainer in an info panel linked from the tooltip.

maria: Next: Error message when a model variant fails to load. Current toast: "Model failed to load. Try again."

devon: Tone is fine but lacking actionability. Add next steps and an error code if available.

maria: Proposed: "Unable to load model variant. Retry or contact support with error code: ERR_MODEL_LOAD."

ash: Can we avoid "contact support" as a first ask? Maybe: "Retry, or if the problem persists contact support (include error code)."

sam: Also add subtle copy for transient cases: "This can happen during deploys; retry in a few moments." (shown only if error flagged as transient).

maria: We'll implement both: primary toast = "Unable to load model variant. Retry, or contact support if the problem persists (error ERR_MODEL_LOAD)." Transient hint: "This can happen during deploys; retry shortly."

olivia: Accessibility: ensure the toast has role=alert and includes the error code in visible text (not just data attribute) so screen readers can read it.

maria: Last one — confirmation dialog for deleting a model variant. Current title: "Delete variant?" Body: "Are you sure you want to delete this variant?" Buttons: "Delete" (danger), "Cancel"

maria: Proposed microcopy: Title: "Delete model variant" Body: "Deleting this variant is permanent. Requests routed to it will fail after deletion. Type the variant name to confirm." Confirm button: "Delete variant" Cancel: "Cancel"

devon: Strong. But if we require typing the name, the primary confirm shouldn't be dangerously color-only — keep it disabled until match. Also show an inline accessible error if the names don't match.

ash: Wording tweak: replace "will fail" with "may fail"? I think permanent deletion causes 404s — precise language is better: "Requests routed to it will return errors after deletion."

maria: Good point. Final body line: "Requests routed to it will return errors after deletion. Type the variant name to confirm."

olivia: Also add focus trap and keyboard accessibility reminder in the implementation ticket.

sam: tiny nit: use sentence case for buttons: "Delete variant" not "Delete Variant"

maria: Great feedback everyone — I'll update the tokens in the design system and post a screenshot of the updated modals later today. Thanks! :raised_hands:

ash: LGTM — thanks for consolidating.

devon: :+1:

olivia: :sparkles:
